description: Pergolesi — Colore: Blue & white texture Codice: 5152 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Classic Scala: Medium Altezza: 141 cm Rapporto: 59.5 cm × 63 cm Toni: Blue The Italian composer Giovanni Battista PERGOLESI burned his candle brightly, although briefly. This 18th-century design, with English influence, celebrates the comic characters and scenes from everyday life in PERGOLESI’s opera buffa. Bustling with creeping and intertwining movement, PERGOLESI’s dense scrolling seems to morph before your eyes.
